description: Describe a space and receive the works that fit it, each with the measurement behind the suggestion and its curatorial capsule. Room light, viewing distance, screen size, attention and movement are measured; collection, resolution, orientation, colour and budget are hard limits, and a work that may be rotated counts for the other orientation. If nothing fits, it says which requirement leaves nothing instead of offering the nearest thing.

attention.description: Should it accompany, or hold the eye?

movement.description: Very still, or full of life? Measured rhythm, on the catalogue scale

orientation.description: ultrawide = at least twice as wide as tall (21:9 and wider); landscape includes it

resolution.description: Only works native to this resolution label (HD, 4K, 8K, 16K…; square works carry their own, such as 2K)

space_description.description: The room in your own words
